<noinclude>{{SbcHeaderLojbanPod|title=I Feel Sick|id=A0016}}</noinclude>
{{SbcIntroductionLojbanPod}}
It's never good when someone doesn't feel well but at least you can use the opportunity to start a small conversation in Lojban. The keywords are '''pobrecito''' – poor guy, and '''¿Qué tienes?''' – What's wrong with you?
{{SbcSourceLojbanPod|[[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0006|A0006: How's it going?]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0076|A0076: Jet-lag]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0116|A0116: Do you want a mint?]]}}
<noinclude>{{SbcAudioLojbanPod|title=I feel sick|id=A0016|dialogueid=A0016 dialogue}}</noinclude>

{{SbcExercisesLojbanPod}}
<noinclude>====Dialogue Translation====
Translate from Lojban to English. Click each bar to check your answer. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| '''Hombre, ¿qué te pasa?'''
| Hey, what's happening to you?
| '''Me siento mal.'''
| I don't feel so good.
| '''¿Qué tienes?'''
| What's wrong with you?
| '''Me duele el estómago.'''
| My stomach hurts.
| '''Pobrecito.'''
| Poor little dude.
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Translation====
Cover the right column, translate from Lojban to English and uncover the right column line by line to check your answers. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| '''Hombre, ¿qué te pasa?'''
| Hey, what's happening to you?
| '''Me siento mal.'''
| I don't feel so good.
| '''¿Qué tienes?'''
| What's wrong with you?
| '''Me duele el estómago.'''
| My stomach hurts.
| '''Pobrecito.'''
| Poor little dude.
}}</includeonly>
<noinclude>====Dialogue Recall====
Now translate from English to Lojban. Remember to say the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| Man, what's happening to you?
| '''Hombre, ¿qué te pasa?'''
| I don't feel so good.
| '''Me siento mal.'''
| What's wrong with you?
| '''¿Qué tienes?'''
| My stomach hurts.
| '''Me duele el estómago.'''
| Poor guy.
| '''Pobrecito.'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Recall====
Now translate from English to Lojban. Remember to say the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| Man, what's happening to you?
| '''Hombre, ¿qué te pasa?'''
| I don't feel so good.
| '''Me siento mal.'''
| What's wrong with you?
| '''¿Qué tienes?'''
| My stomach hurts.
| '''Me duele el estómago.'''
| Poor guy.
| '''Pobrecito.'''
}}</includeonly>
<noinclude>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestion
| Hey!
| '''¡Hombre!'''
| What's up? ({{=}} What happens?) 
| '''¿Qué pasa?'''
| I feel very ({{=}} '''muy''') bad.
| '''Me siento muy mal.'''
| What's your problem?
| '''¿Qué tienes?'''
| I have a headache. ({{=}} The head ({{=}} '''la cabeza''') hurts to me.)
| '''Me duele la cabeza.'''
| I feel sorry. ({{=}} It ({{=}} '''lo''') I feel.)
| '''Lo siento.'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| Hey!
| '''¡Hombre!'''
| What's up? ({{=}} What happens?) 
| '''¿Qué pasa?'''
| I feel very ({{=}} '''muy''') bad.
| '''Me siento muy mal.'''
| What's your problem?
| '''¿Qué tienes?'''
| I have a headache. ({{=}} The head ({{=}} '''la cabeza''') hurts to me.)
| '''Me duele la cabeza.'''
| I feel sorry. ({{=}} It ({{=}} '''lo''') I feel.)
| '''Lo siento.'''
}}</includeonly>
<noinclude>====Dialogue Recast====
This translation exercise requires some of the words from the [[#More Vocabulary|More Vocabulary]] section.
{{SbcQuestion
| What's happening to you? (formal, plural)
| '''¿Qué les pasa?'''
| We don't feel so good.
| '''Nos sentimos mal.'''
| What's wrong with you? (formal, plural)
| '''¿Qué tienen (ustedes)?'''
| My stomach hurts.
| '''Me duele el estómago.'''
| Poor little guy.
| '''Pobrecito.'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Recast====
This translation exercise requires some of the words from the More Vocabulary section.

| We don't feel so good.
